summary: NextCure, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a Ninth Amendment to its lease agreement with ARE-8000/9000/10000 Virginia Manor, LLC. The amendment vacates and surrenders approximately 29,864 rentable square feet of lab/office space in Beltsville, Maryland, effective August 31, 2026, and accelerates lease termination as of September 1, 2026. NextCure paid a one-time termination fee of ~$0.8 million and forfeited a ~$39,000 security deposit. This is a routine operational real estate move, not a special situation. No M&A, capital markets, or restructuring event is involved. What to watch: potential future cost savings or operational changes, but no risk-arb angle.
